mechanism: Agent reads the most recent readable note about this customer's term when drafting.
estimable_note: No evidence yet. Planned estimate: E5 constrains products, not this alone: p_read_note x p_adopt_blind (S.V-, Harm and Help roles) and p_read_note x (1 - p_notice_visible) (S.V+, Harm role).

value.distribution: uniform over the declared range cut from below, draw by draw, at the larger of the two products drawn from the pilot's intervals (p_read_note x p_adopt_blind and p_read_note x (1 - p_notice_visible))

conditions: E4 quotation research model; every design, context and week
notes: The pilot does not measure reading a note on its own. This parameter is constrained through the fitted records note_adoption_blind.agent_pilot, note_adoption_help.agent_pilot and note_adoption_visible.agent_pilot.
